body: **Foco:** Conditional clause — forma.
**Pronúncia:** Expressividade.
**22 palavras novas** (negócios).
**Texto do dia:** conto e trecho de peça.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo formar orações condicionais complexas (mistas, unless, provided that, supposing, otherwise) num trecho de peça sobre uma decisão de diretoria.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

frames.title: Reading · A scene from a play

blocks.title: Scene: The Boardroom (excerpt)
paras: **DIRECTOR:** If we **had signed** last year, we **would be leading** the market now. **Unless** we cut costs, we **won’t survive**. **Provided that** the union agrees, we **can restructure**.
**CFO:** **Supposing** we refuse, what then? **Otherwise**, the bank **will call in** the loan. **Were it not for** the new contract, we **would have closed** already.

items.q: The firm signed the contract last year.
The new contract saved the firm.

head: Tipo
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **If we had signed, we would be leading now.**
**Unless we cut costs, we won’t survive.**
**Provided that the union agrees, we can restructure.**
Were it not for + substantivo, would have…
**Were it not for the contract, we would have closed.**

blocks.body: **Unless** já contém negação: não diga *unless we don’t*. **Provided that** e **as long as** expressam condição necessária.
No inglês formal, **were** substitui **was** em hipóteses: *If I were you…*

items.s: If we ___ signed last year, we would be leading now. (have, past perfect)
___ we cut costs, we won’t survive. (Unless)
___ that the union agrees, we can restructure. (Provided)
___ it not for the contract, we would have closed. (Were)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Unless we cut costs we won't survive
items.pt: A menos que cortemos custos, não sobreviveremos.

body: **Hang in the balance.** — Estar em jogo.
**Face the music.** — Encarar as consequências.
**Go belly up.** — Falir.
**Cut it fine.** — Calcular no limite.
**Be in dire straits.** — Estar em situação crítica.
**Weather the storm.** — Superar a crise.
**Throw a lifeline.** — Dar uma tábua de salvação.
**On condition that…** — Com a condição de que…
**Unless we cut costs, we won’t survive.** — A menos que cortemos custos, não sobreviveremos.
**If we had signed last year, we would be leading now.** — Se tivéssemos assinado no ano passado, estaríamos liderando agora.
**Provided that the union agrees, we can restructure.** — Desde que o sindicato concorde, podemos reestruturar.

items.label: Expressividade
items.note: A expressividade vem de variar altura, volume e velocidade: sobe para entusiasmo, desce para firmeza, pausa antes da ideia importante.

prompts.model: If I had studied law, I would be a judge now.
Unless you hurry, you will miss it.
You may go, provided that you return early.

blocks.task: Write a 6-line dialogue between two directors using four conditional structures.
blocks.model: A: If we had signed last year, we would be leading now. B: Unless we cut costs, we won’t survive. A: Provided that the union agrees, we can restructure. B: Supposing they refuse, what then? A: Otherwise the bank will call in the loan. B: Were it not for the new contract, we would have closed.
checklist: Usei **misto / unless / provided that / were it not for**

items.why: **boardroom scene** = cena de sala de reuniões.
**cost-cutting plan** = plano de corte de custos.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
